name: Speckled Stoneware Mug
summary: Wheel-thrown 12 oz mug in our oatmeal speckle glaze.
description: Each mug is thrown by hand in our studio, trimmed, and glazed in a soft oatmeal speckle. Holds about 12 oz. Dishwasher and microwave safe. Because every piece is handmade, size and glaze will vary slightly.

reviews.author: Megan R.
reviews.title: My new morning mug
reviews.body: The speckle is even nicer in person and the handle fits three fingers. It keeps coffee warm longer than my old mugs.

reviews.author: Daniel K.
reviews.title: Bought two more
reviews.body: Got one as a gift for my sister, then ordered two for us. Each one is a little different, which I like.

reviews.author: Priya S.
reviews.title: Lovely, slightly smaller than expected
reviews.body: Beautiful glaze and very solid. It holds a regular coffee, not a big latte, so check the size if you like a large cup.

name: Pour-Over Coffee Dripper
summary: Single-cup ceramic dripper, fits #2 cone filters.
description: A ceramic cone dripper with spiral ribs for an even pour. Sits on most mugs and carafes. Fits standard #2 paper filters (not included). Glazed gloss white inside and out.

reviews.author: Tom H.
reviews.title: Even extraction
reviews.body: The ribs keep the filter off the wall so it drains evenly. Heavier than plastic, which keeps it steady on the mug.

reviews.author: Alicia M.
reviews.title: Great, preheat it first
reviews.body: Makes a clean cup. Ceramic soaks up heat, so rinse it with hot water before brewing.

name: Ash Glaze Serving Bowl
summary: Wide 10 in serving bowl with a runny ash glaze.
description: Our largest bowl, made for salads, pasta and fruit. The pale wood-ash glaze pools and runs during firing, so no two are the same. About 10 inches across and 3 inches deep.

reviews.author: Hannah L.
reviews.title: Centerpiece of the table
reviews.body: The glaze has a soft sea-glass color. Big enough for a salad for six and it looks great empty on the counter too.

reviews.author: Chris P.
reviews.title: Worth the wait
reviews.body: Picked it up at the studio. Solid, smooth inside, and it has survived the dishwasher for months.

name: Espresso Cup Set (4)
summary: Four 3 oz cups in mixed glazes. Back in stock soon.
description: A set of four small cups for espresso or cortado, each in a different glaze from our seasonal range. About 3 oz each. Colors vary from set to set.

reviews.author: Marco V.
reviews.title: Perfect size for a double
reviews.body: Thick walls keep the shot hot. The four glazes look great together on the shelf.

reviews.author: Jess W.
reviews.title: Pretty set
reviews.body: Lovely colors. I wish the blue one came as its own set.

name: Everyday Mug, Chalk White
summary: Our simplest mug in a satin chalk-white glaze.
description: A straight-sided mug with a wide handle and a satin white glaze that is smooth to the touch. Holds about 11 oz. Made to stack two high in a cupboard.

reviews.author: Olivia T.
reviews.title: Simple and well made
reviews.body: Exactly what I wanted, a plain white mug that feels handmade. The satin finish is really nice.

reviews.author: Sam D.
reviews.title: Good everyday mug
reviews.body: Sturdy and stacks well. Handle is a bit small for big hands.

name: Short Tea Cup
summary: A low 8 oz cup for tea, with a small loop handle.
description: A short, wide tea cup with a thin rim and a small loop handle. Glazed gloss white so the color of your tea shows. Holds about 8 oz.

reviews.author: Eleanor B.
reviews.title: Delicate rim
reviews.body: The thin rim makes tea taste better, I swear. Lovely shape.

reviews.author: Kenji O.
reviews.title: Bought a set of four
reviews.body: Ordered four over two orders and they match well. Good weight in the hand.

name: Speckled Carafe and Cups
summary: A 20 oz pouring carafe with two handleless cups.
description: A tall carafe for water, sake or cold brew, with two handleless cups. All three are glazed in our white speckle over a toasted clay foot. The carafe holds about 20 oz.

reviews.author: Leah G.
reviews.title: Beautiful gift
reviews.body: Gave it as a wedding gift and it was a hit. Pours without dripping.

reviews.author: Victor J.
reviews.title: Lovely set
reviews.body: Nice speckle and pours cleanly. The cups are small, closer to sake cups.

name: Nesting Bowls (Set of 2)
summary: Two cereal bowls that nest, one honey, one pattern.
description: Two 6 inch bowls for cereal, rice or noodles. One is glazed in honey amber, the other carved with a simple diamond pattern under a blue-grey glaze. They nest for storage.

reviews.author: Nora C.
reviews.title: Perfect cereal bowls
reviews.body: Just the right size. The carved one is my favorite thing in the kitchen.

reviews.author: Will E.
reviews.title: Pretty pair
reviews.body: Good quality. I would buy a set of four if you made one.

name: Dinner Plates, Sky Glaze (Set of 4)
summary: Four 10.5 in dinner plates in a soft sky-blue glaze.
description: Four dinner plates with a gentle rim and a sky-blue glaze that breaks lighter at the edges. Each is about 10.5 inches across. Made in small batches, so the blue varies a little from plate to plate.

reviews.author: Isabel M.
reviews.title: Gorgeous color
reviews.body: The blue changes in different light. They feel substantial without being too heavy.

reviews.author: Patrick Q.
reviews.title: Well packed
reviews.body: Arrived safely in lots of paper. Every plate is a little different, as described.

reviews.author: Dana Y.
reviews.title: Lovely plates
reviews.body: Beautiful, though they take up more cupboard space than my old set.

name: Bud Vase, Matte White
summary: A small rounded vase for a single stem or sprig.
description: A small, rounded bud vase in a matte white glaze with a narrow neck that holds a single stem upright. Glazed inside, so it holds water. About 5 inches tall.

reviews.author: Amy Z.
reviews.title: Simple and sweet
reviews.body: Lives on my desk with whatever is growing outside. Matte glaze is lovely.

reviews.author: Luis R.
reviews.title: Great small gift
reviews.body: Bought three for friends. Nicely packed and arrived fast.

name: Bud Vase Pair with Oak Tray
summary: Two tall white bud vases on a shaped oak tray.
description: Two slim bud vases in gloss white, sold with a shaped oak tray made by a woodworker down the road from our studio. The vases are about 7 inches tall.
details: Wipe the tray, do not soak

reviews.author: Claire D.
reviews.title: So pretty on the table
reviews.body: The tray makes it feel finished. Looks great with a few dried stems.

reviews.author: Omar S.
reviews.title: Nice piece
reviews.body: The oak is beautiful. One vase was a touch taller than the other, which is fine for handmade.

name: Bottle Vases, Stone Grey (Set of 3)
summary: Three bottle-shaped vases in a speckled stone glaze.
description: Three bottle vases in two heights, glazed in a speckled stone grey that shows the clay underneath. Good for dried flowers and single branches. The tallest is about 9 inches.

reviews.author: Fiona K.
reviews.title: Stunning trio
reviews.body: They look like they came from a gallery. The speckle is subtle and beautiful.

reviews.author: George T.
reviews.title: Love them
reviews.body: Bought these for the mantel. Great with dried poppies.
